name: 10867-longprompt-8bfp8-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine on one GPU.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, bf16 base, compressed-tensors W8A8 fp8; ~10 GB of weights. All of it reads off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: poisson, rate=10 req/s, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1200 requests with a 900 s safety cap, seed static 10867. 10 req/s is loaded and stable: the engine is busy and still retires the offered rate.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, one prefix bucket (bucket_weight 100, prefix_count 1, prefix_tokens 200); prompt exactly 1848 tokens and output exactly 128 (min = max on both), so each request is 200 shared + 1848 unique = 2048 prompt tokens. The backend wraps prefix and prompt as chat messages and applies the checkpoint's template, so the engine's own count reads ~2060 rather than 2048.
purpose: A document question-answering assistant on one GPU, serving ten requests per second with shared instructions and 2000-token prompts.
launch:
# Launch config for 10867-longprompt-8bfp8-1gpu. Every argument below is passed straight to
# AsyncEngineArgs (`-` becomes `_`) on the engine pinned in setupcard.md (`commit_id`).
#
# 0.8.4-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction, so do not
# add keys from a later vLLM. A flow mapping must stay on ONE line -- the config reader takes
# this file line by line and skips indented ones, so a re-flowed value is silently dropped.

model: neuralmagic/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 131072
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
block-size: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
compilation-config: {"level": 3, "custom_ops": ["all"]}
